text: The absence of standardized protocols for dispute resolution and for compliance with regulations such as export controls hinders the scalability of tokenized real world assets and other blockchain based applications.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218
